# evidence-gated-medical-agent-demo

> Machine-readable orientation for automated readers. Canonical human docs:
> README.md (overview + Quickstart), VERIFICATION.md (acceptance contract),
> ATTESTATION.md (authorship + integrity), manifest.json (SHA-256 inventory).

## Purpose

A dependency-free Python demo (one script plus one required JSON failure-rule
catalog, standard library only) of a runtime evidence gate for a fictional
hospital-deployed medical AI agent. It illustrates: registry state,
"evidence absent" vs "evidence found wrong", change-triggered re-evaluation,
population-drift silent failure, pause / rollback / re-verify / resume, and a
deterministic JSON audit receipt with a chain digest.

## Run

    python lgd_medai_demo.py          # from repo root, Python 3.10+, stdlib only

Requires failure_rules.json beside the script; copying only the .py file
exits 1 with FileNotFoundError.
Expected: exit 0, final_state = RESUMED, log receipts DENIED / PAUSE /
ROLLBACK / RESUMED. See VERIFICATION.md for the full acceptance contract.

## Files

- lgd_medai_demo.py   — state machine, gate, monitoring, change gate
- failure_rules.json  — 3 silent-failure signal → gate-action mappings
- README.md           — overview, Quickstart, scope
- VERIFICATION.md     — independent verification contract
- ATTESTATION.md      — authorship, licence boundary, anchors
- manifest.json       — SHA-256 + byte size of every file
- LICENSE             — Apache-2.0 full text
- llms.txt            — this file
